label: exploratory
hypothesis: pandoc 3.6.3 to Typst and the typst 0.15.0 Python package can produce a PDF from research/paper/manuscript.md without a TeX distribution
hardware: Apple M1 Pro, 10 cores, 16 GB, macOS 15.3.1
result: First attempt failed: typst.TypstError 'font fallback list must not be empty' (pandoc template emits font: () when mainfont is unset). Second attempt with -V mainfont="Libertinus Serif" compiled a 3-page PDF of the heading-only skeleton; page 1 inspected as PNG (title, metadata line, page number). PDF kept in the session scratchpad only, not committed. pandoc -t latex produced research/paper/manuscript.tex (not compiled).
failures: font fallback list must not be empty (fixed by setting mainfont)
interpretation: Zero-cost PDF path works for the skeleton; figures, tables, equations and citations remain untested until M4.
